many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import numpy as np
from collections import deque, Counter
def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def nbrs(a,b): return [(a+da,b+db) for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=a+da<h and 0<=b+db<w]
    noise=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg and all(g[x][y]==bg for x,y in nbrs(i,j))]
    objs=[];seen=set()
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==bg or (i,j) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(i,j)]);c=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.popleft()
                if(a,b) in seen:continue
                seen.add((a,b));c.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<h and 0<=w and g[x][y]!=bg and (x,y) not in seen: q.append((x,y))
            objs.append(c)
    # absorb noise into nearest object, recolor to that object's majority color
    absorbed=[[] for _ in objs]
    for i,j,v in noise:
        best=min(((abs(i-a)+abs(j-b)),k) for k,o in enumerate(objs))
        cnt=Counter(g[a][b] for a,b in objs[best[1]]); main=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        absorbed[best[1]].append((i,j,main))
    for k,cells in zip(range(len(objs)),absorbed):
        for a,b,v in cells: g[a][b]=v
    objs=[];seen=set()
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==bg or (i,j) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(i,j)]);c=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.popleft()
                if(a,b) in seen:continue
                seen.add((a,b));c.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<h and y<=w-1 and g[x][y]!=bg and (x,y) not in seen: q.append((x,y))
            objs.append(c)
    objs.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
    grid=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    used=set()
    for c in objs:
        cells=c
        # slide up maximally
        while all(0<=a-1 and grid[a-1][b]==bg for a,b in cells):
            for a,b in cells: a-=1
        # slide left maximally until touching another placed object or col0
        while True:
            stop=False
            if any(b-1<0 for a,b in cells): break
            if any(grid[a][b-1]!=bg for a,b in cells): break
            for a,b in cells: b-=1
            stop=True
        for a,b in cells: grid[a][b]=g[a][b]
    return grid

def grow(inp,outg,bg,dcol,border=True):
    L={k:set((r,c) for r in range(len(inp)) for c in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[r][c]==k) for k in set(x for r in inp for x in r)-{bg,dcol}}
    # assign dust to shape sharing a side (4-conn) if exists; else 8-conn
    G={k:set() for k in L}
    for n in [(r,c) for r in range(len(inp)) for c in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[r][c]==dcol]:
        hosts=[k for k,S in L.items() if any(abs(n[0]-r)<=1 and abs(n[1]-c)<=1 for r,c in S)]
        # prefer side adjacency
        sides=[k for k,S in L.items() if any((n[0]+dr,n[1]+dc) in S for dr,dc in[(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)])]
        host=sides[0] if sides else hosts[0]
        G[host].add(n)
    outs={k:set((r,c) for r in range(len(outg)) for c in range(len(outg[0])) if outg[r][c]==k) for k in L}
    for k,Gk in G.items():
        A=L[k]|Gk
        d=(min(r for r,c in outs[k])-min(r for r,c in A), min(c for r,c in outs[k])-min(c for r,c in A))
        if {(r+d[0],c+d[1]) for r,c in A}!=outs[k]: return None,(d,sorted(A),sorted(outs[k]))

import os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

    Hh=len(t); Ww=len(t[0])

    for idx in order:
        cells=set(comps[idx]); moved=None
        for d in range(max(Hh,Ww)):
            cand=[(p-d,q-d) for p,q in cells]
            if any(p<0 or q<0 or p>=Hh or q>=Ww for p,q in cand): break
            if any(out[p][q]!=bg and (p,q) not in cells for p,q in cand): break
            placed=all(out[p][q]==bg for p,q in cand)
            if placed:
                for p,q in cells: out[p][q]=bg
                for p,q in cand: out[p][q]=t[p+d][q+d]

        if not moved: occ|=cells; continue

for d in range(1,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {d} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {d} output']

    vals=set(x for row in gi for x in row)-{bg}
    best=[]
    for mc in vals:
        t=[[bg if x==mc else x for x in row] for row in gi]
        o=fpack(t,bg)
        rs=[r for r in range(len(o)) if any(x!=bg for x in o[r])]

                while st:

                        for dc in(-1,0,1):

# Plan: define f via separator-line detection. Rule sketch:
# - find full uniform horizontal separator line(s) and vertical separator column(s)
# - keep the quadrant (one of 4 blocks cut by them) that contains the pattern
# - output = kaleidoscope (mirror that quadrant about the separator lines' positions), colors shifted: pattern color -> separator color?

import itertools
def analyze(i,o,name):
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0])
    hsep=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(i[r]))==1]
    vsep=[c for c in range(W) if len({i[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    # non-uniform rows / cols are the "content"
    content_r=[r for r in range(H) if r not in hsep]
    content_c=[c for c in range(W) if c not in vsep]
    # background = most common value among content
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(i[r][c] for r in content_r for c in content_c)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    print(name,'hseps',hsep,'vseps',vsep,'bg',bg)
    return
